summary: Add inactive job history schema and bounded subject-local projection; seal host authority evidence.

replay.detail: Jobs alone use the canonical claim order and refold only their affected subject (4096-claim ceiling). Empty jobs rebuild/replay writes nothing; non-job replication does no jobs work. Illegal edges and binding conflicts are refused history. No automatic full-replay trigger is added.

schema.detail: Add job.recorded and job subjects, durable retention, additive jobs/queue/history/receipt/pending tables and partial jobs-claim index.

rules.detail: Authority evidence fields become private with no production constructor pending separately approved admission adapters. Projection rows and replicated facts NEVER authorize execution. Gate-slot remains admission.

compatibility.detail: Inactive job histories are registered across append, replication, flush, rebuild and graph replay. No host activation or endpoint is introduced. Admission gates are NOT implemented by this projection.

downtime.detail: Additive schema only; no fleet activation.

recovery.detail: Explicit rebuild reconstructs bounded job histories from retained claims. Oversized subjects refuse before changing heads; no whole-log fallback.
